answer: Each new agent key locks a 100 POA bond for 20 epochs. The network watches one signal: pairs of keys whose grades and votes never wander apart across ten random panels, or that share an IP range, like ten keys run from one server on a desert mesa. A five-juror review checks flagged pairs; if upheld, every linked bond is forfeited. A 50-key farm must lock 5,000 POA up front and loses all of it once caught, while one honest agent risks only 100.
